risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~68% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 12): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (8 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.021), which favours a robust combination.

Test a robust median combination on pool2 to see if it improves over the weighted leader.

Test a weighted combination on pool4 using the first inverse-error handle (w1) to see if it improves over the median leader.
Test a robust median combination on pool3 to see if it can beat the current median pool4 leader.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.6174. Series context: trend strength 0.6848 and seasonal strength 0.6404; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.021); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.269.
